description: This file contains utility functions for data manipulation and algorithmic operations, including topological sorting, dictionary reversal, grouping collections, and type name retrieval, used within the PyTorch FX experimental unification module.

methods.name: raises
methods.description: Checks if executing a lambda raises a specified error.

methods.name: expand_tuples
methods.description: Expands a list containing tuples into a list of tuples with all combinations.

methods.name: _toposort
methods.description: Performs a topological sort on a directed graph represented by edges.

methods.name: reverse_dict
methods.description: Reverses the direction of dependencies in a dictionary.

methods.name: groupby
methods.description: Groups elements of a sequence by a key function.

methods.name: typename
methods.description: Returns the name of a type or a tuple of types.
